During my undergrad, I studied Biomedical Science at the University of Calgary. After graduating, I stayed at the University of Calgary and worked for an epidemiology research group focusing on global rates of inflammatory bowel disease. Having spent time working with data and self-learning many data science adjacent skills, I felt I would benefit from a broad overview of the fundamentals. I am currently pursuing a Master's of Data Science at the University of British Columbia to flesh out my analytical skills while getting connected to the data science community here in Vancouver.
